name: beautiful-python
description: Write, review, port, and enforce idiomatic Python: three skills distilled from PEP 8 and PEP 20, PEP 257, the Google Python Style Guide, Effective Python, and the typing docs, plus a drop-in ruff and mypy config.

interface.longDescription:
Three skills for Python developers, distilled from PEP 8 and PEP 20, PEP 257, the Google Python Style Guide, Effective Python, and the typing documentation.

python-best-practices guides new Python code: data modeling, typing, errors, imports, concurrency, packaging, tests, and docs. It includes guidance for the FastAPI + TaskIQ + Dragonfly + Postgres/pgvector backend stack.

python-review reviews a file, module, package, or diff and returns a prioritized report. Every finding cites a file and line, the rule it breaks, and the smallest fix.

python-port ports C, C++, Rust, Go, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript to idiomatic Python with the same behavior. It ports the original tests first and writes a PORTING.md that lists every deliberate difference.

The skills contain instructions and reference text only. They make no network calls and collect no data. When linters are available, the skills run ruff, mypy, and pytest on your project; without them, they work from the code alone. A drop-in ruff and mypy config is available in the GitHub repository.
capabilities: Review Python code with cited rules
Port code to Python with the same behavior
defaultPrompt: Review this Python package and list what to fix first
Port this C module to idiomatic Python
Write a Python function that parses this config format

publication.release_notes: Initial release: the three skills, the FastAPI + TaskIQ stack reference, and every Python example compiled in CI.
